title: ranunculus pusillus var. typicus
intro: Ranunculus pusillus var. typicus, commonly known as small-flowered buttercup, is a plant species belonging to the Ranunculaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its numerous health benefits. The plant is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of infections and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Ranunculus pusillus var. typicus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
